rows.en: Bogarl...!! If you're coming, then come on!! I'll take you on!!
Bogarl...!! Is it coming at us!?
A powerful aura of terror is rising from the pitch-black floor ahead!!
This feeling of fear... It's no good... I can't stop shaking...
I-is that thing somewhere close by...?
What is this...? I'm sensing a tremendous fear.
The hell? ...It ain't even cold, but I can't stop shaking!
Why...? Why am I, of all people, feeling fear!?

notes.note: #0.29-30 are extra Bogal leader variants after the block in story_091 (#0.14-25). #0.29 uses ore (rough/confident); #0.30 = identical wording to #0.16 etc. in story_091 ('Is it coming!?'); subject restored as Bogal coming at the party.
#0.1-15: 15-slot leader block of identical gasps; kept identical.
Script shows #0.17/#0.18 under the leader-slot name (CHARA_NAME.10 = 00 placeholder, extractor labels 00). #0.17 rough 'nee' wording; voiced neutral-rough.

Leader block #0.18-31 (+18+k). Pt_Chara_Check order 4,5,3,2,1,11-15,6-10 = W, OOO, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero(, 00). Wording fits: #0.20 rough = Momotaros, #0.27 = Zero, #0.29 'pressure' = Zeta/Kamille, #0.30 = Domon. The 00-labelled speaker on #0.18-19 is the extractor's placeholder, not 00. 'Yatsu' (that guy/thing) rendered 'that thing' since the referent (likely Bogal or whatever lurks) is unclear.
'Field' kept for the source's katakana field (the area/aura zone).

#0.2-16: 15-slot leader block (same order as 0515). #0.2 and #0.11 use rough 'nee' = W (Shotaro) and Zero; #0.4 'kuso/mitee' = Momotaros; #0.15-16 (Wing Zero, 00) end in a question. Identical Japanese kept identical.

#0.1-8 appear to be an alternate/unused W-specific version of the scene (the script plays #0.14 onward). Extractor labels #0.2/#0.5/#0.8 as 00, but Taboo replies 'you're Kamen Rider W' and the speaker knows the Museum and the Xtreme Memory, so it is W (Shotaro); lines written for W.
'Ki ni itte itadaketa kashira' = polite/ironic 'did you come to like it'; rendered 'Are you enjoying the Museum?' (Taboo, f).
#0.15-28: 14-slot leader block, identical except #0.16 (rough 'nanda'a? omae!' = Momotaros) -> 'Who the hell are you!'.
Unnamed ??? speaker is Taboo Dopant introducing herself. 'Museum' = the Sonozaki family's organization from Kamen Rider W, capitalized.
#0.30-36 (block continues in story_093): identical 'Museum?' replies from leaders who don't know the organization.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks voiced via Pt_Chara_Check order (W, OOO, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Ultras, Gundams). 0518 #0.1-8 speaker label '00' corrected to W by context (Taboo names him Kamen Rider W). 0515 #0.18 'yatsu' referent unclear (rendered 'that thing'). New term: Museum (Kamen Rider W organization) not in glossary.
